title:
Triggered on `PRIMARY_BUTTON_CLICK` of `Reliability.AdditionalSensorSelectionModal` to add the sensors selected in `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsGrid`.
The epic performs the following:
--  1. Updates `additionalRasrs` and `additionalSensors` stored in state.
--  2. Runs {@link ReliabilityAsset#generateSensorDataReport} for the selected additional sensors.
--  3. Requests data for `Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid` and `Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid`.
name: AddAdditionalSensorsEpic
